sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:24

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:24:1
items.html:
The fourth degree, which is that the male and the female are face to face: The first two degrees, back to back and back to face, are drawn through the posterior of Ima, and the third degree is drawn through the upper coupling of AB SAG, which lowers the bottom Hey from the Einayim, as above. And this correction avails only the male, to attain his face as at first; but the Nukva is still cleaved to the force of her posterior, and she chooses Hassadim rather, and rejects Hochma, as above. Therefore Bina needs a raising of MAN [female waters] from the lower ones, who are ZON, for only then is she compelled to cease the force of her posterior and to turn her face toward Hochma. And she does this only for the benefit of ZON, since she cannot draw the illumination of Hochma to them otherwise. And therefore she returns face to face with Hochma, which is the fourth degree.
And know that the matter of the raising of MAN, which returns HB to face to face, is rooted still further back in the ten Sefirot of direct light. For the Bina of direct light is the light of Hassadim and not Hochma (as written in the Inner Light, Part 1, page 5, the passage beginning “and the reason”), and therefore she too is discerned as though her posterior were toward Hochma. However, at the time when she wishes to emanate ZA, whose whole essence is the illumination of Hochma, as written there, she is then compelled to turn her face toward Hochma, face to face, in order to receive from him the illumination of Hochma for the sake of the ZA of direct light. Thus, so long as she does not emanate ZA, she is found with her posterior toward Hochma; and after she emanates ZA, she is found face to face with Hochma, in order to draw his illumination to him. And you find that the root source of the state of HB face to face is the ZA of direct light.
And with this you will better understand the words of the ARI above (page 349, Part 5, item 51), where he says that the light of Hesed given in Bina, which is the light of ZA, always remains in her as MAN. Study it there well. That is, as above: at the time when Bina wishes to draw the Gadlut [greatness/adulthood] of the light of Hesed in order to emanate it to its place, she is then compelled to turn her face toward Hochma; and therefore this light of Hesed is reckoned to Bina as MAN, meaning that which causes her a coupling face to face with Hochma.
And now the secret of the raising of MAN has been well explained: it means the cause that awakens the coupling of HB. For without this cause, HB would not couple face to face, because of the posterior of Bina, which rejects Hochma, in the secret of “for He delights in mercy.” And this cause is ZON, since they are the children of Bina, and their whole essence is only the illumination of Hochma. For the entire difference between the Bina of direct light and the ZON of direct light lies solely in that illumination of Hochma which Bina draws for the sake of ZA, since both of them are a light of Hassadim; only that Bina is a light of Hassadim without any illumination of Hochma, while ZA is with the illumination of Hochma (as written above, Part 1, page 5, in the Inner Light, the passage beginning “and the reason”; study it there well). And therefore no coupling of Gadlut for AVI [Aba ve Ima] can be conceived without the rising of MAN, for so long as ZON do not rise as MAN to Bina, she is bound to the craving to draw Hassadim, which is the essence of her structure from the side of the direct light itself, as explained. And remember these words in every place where anything is said of the raising of MAN.
